summary: Known community.general issue: with ansible-core Data Tagging, the reveal_ansible_type filter and ansible_type test see new type aliases such as _AnsibleTaggedStr, _AnsibleTaggedInt and _AnsibleTaggedFloat.
questions: Does the ansible_type test handle data tagging types?

answer_card.title: Tagged type names in reveal_ansible_type
answer_card.answer_md: With ansible-core's Data Tagging, `reveal_ansible_type` and the `ansible_type` test may report aliases like `_AnsibleTaggedStr` (str), `_AnsibleTaggedInt` (int) and `_AnsibleTaggedFloat` (float).
